content_generation_note: Phrase-family table for near-related collocation planning. Families are not production lessons and are not automatic distractor sets.

family_policy.grouping_rule: Group phrases by first English token when at least two reference phrases share that token.
family_policy.usage_rule: Treat groups as contrast candidates. A same-family phrase is not automatically a valid distractor.
family_policy.ambiguity_rule: Before authoring, verify that only the correct phrase can complete the sentence.

families.authoring_use: Use as a reference for semantic contrast and distractor planning only; manually check ambiguity before authoring.
